children: EnerSys
), a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial, infrastructure, and defense applications, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Ultralife (

) for $16.00 per share in cash, representing a 166% premium to Ultralife’s unaffected closing share price on October 26, 2026. The transaction represents an enterprise value of approximately $320 million. EnerSys expects to realize $15 million to $20 million in annual run-rate cost synergies within the first 18 months, reflecting the unique benefits of combining Ultralife with EnerSys.

Ultralife is a leading provider of rechargeable and non-rechargeable batteries, battery systems, and related accessories for military communications and other specialized applications. The company serves government, defense, and commercial customers globally and generated $191 million in revenue in fiscal 2025. Headquartered in Newark, New York, Ultralife employs more than 700 people, with principal operations across the U.S., Canada, U.K., and China.

“This acquisition is a compelling strategic fit for EnerSys and directly advances our strategy to build a broader, more differentiated defense power platform,” said Shawn O'Connell, President and Chief Executive Officer of EnerSys. “Building on the success of our recent acquisitions, Ultralife expands our portfolio of advanced, reliable, high-performance power solutions. Together, we will be better positioned to support the U.S. Department of War (DoW) and allied forces with leading-edge, cost-effective technologies for the increasingly electrified battlefield of the future. We know the Ultralife business and its team well, and are confident that our shared commitment to engineering, problem solving, and customer focus will create a strong cultural fit. We look forward to combining our strengths to accelerate growth, enhance performance, and deliver greater value to our customers and shareholders.”

Mark Matthews, Chief Technology Officer and President, Precision Power Solutions, added, “Ultralife complements our multi-chemistry expertise and our liquid reserve technologies with an impressive patent portfolio and strong, longstanding customer relationships. Ultralife’s products offer exceptional capabilities such as very high energy density, long shelf life, low self-discharge, useful pulse power, and cold-weather performance, which are ideally suited to the growing defense mission profiles of today and tomorrow.”

“Combining with EnerSys is an exciting next step that will allow us to unlock value and growth opportunities for both companies, while delivering substantial and certain cash value to Ultralife shareholders,” said Michael Manna, President and Chief Executive Officer of Ultralife. “This transaction is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our entire organization, and now offers even greater opportunities for our valued employees. We look forward to partnering with the EnerSys team with the combined scale, resources, and shared vision to accelerate innovation and better serve our global customer base.”
Acquisition Expected to Offer Compelling Strategic and Financial Benefits
Expands EnerSys’ advanced defense power technology portfolio

with the addition of Ultralife’s differentiated multi-chemistry capabilities, purpose-built advanced manufacturing capacity with existing security and environmental permits, and operational expertise to scale production of EnerSys’ proprietary liquid reserve battery technology.
Increases scale and broadens exposure to the large and rapidly growing defense market
with capabilities across mission-critical applications in munitions, soldier power, drones, counter drones, and autonomous systems accelerating EnerSys’ focused growth strategy.
Deepens customer relationships
by creating a broader, Foreign Entity of Concern (FEOC)-compliant product portfolio for U.S. DoW and allied customers.
Supports an attractive financial profile.

The transaction is expected to be accretive to adjusted diluted earnings per share within approximately 18 months after closing, excluding transaction and integration costs and other non-recurring items.
Transaction Details and Timing

The transaction will be funded through cash on hand. The transaction has been unanimously approved by the Boards of Directors of both companies. Under the terms of the merger agreement, EnerSys, through a subsidiary, will commence a tender offer to acquire all of the outstanding shares of Ultralife common stock at a price of $16.00 per share in cash at closing, representing a total enterprise value of approximately $320 million. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including the tender of at least a majority of the outstanding shares of Ultralife’s common stock and receipt of applicable regulatory approvals, and is expected to close in the first quarter of calendar year 2027.
Advisors
XMS Capital Partners, LLC is serving as financial advisor to EnerSys, and Reed Smith LLP is serving as legal counsel to EnerSys in connection with the transaction.
About EnerSys

EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions helping industrial, infrastructure and defense customers address critical power and operational needs with batteries, chargers and other power equipment. The company delivers integrated solutions that combine energy storage technologies, power electronics, software-enabled intelligence, technical expertise and comprehensive global customer support. EnerSys supports customers across communications networks, data centers, energy infrastructure, material handling, transportation, aerospace and defense — including applications where power continuity is essential. Serving customers in more than 100 countries, EnerSys helps organizations manage energy more reliably, efficiently and intelligently in complex operating environments where uptime, safety and resilience matter. For more information, visit www.enersys.com.
About Ultralife

Ultralife Corporation serves its markets with products and services ranging from power solutions to communications and electronics systems. Through its engineering and collaborative approach to problem solving, Ultralife serves government/defense and commercial customers across the globe.

Headquartered in Newark, New York, the Company's business segments include Battery & Energy Products and Communications Systems. Ultralife has operations in North America, Europe and Asia. For more information, visit www.ultralifecorporation.com.
